htmlLang.how: meta.lang, which wf init writes, and a page's own lang:.

title.how: Each page's title:, which every page declares.

description.how: Each page's description:, else meta.description; S02 warns of a page with none.

contentInHtml.how: A static build paints every page into its HTML (wf init -t static).
contentInHtml.note: The single-page template draws in the browser instead.

openGraph.how: Built from each page's title, description and image.

skipLink.how: Every page gets a skip link to its main content.

csp.how: build.csp, which wf init turns on, writes the policy and holds the build to it.

frameOptions.how: With the policy, frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options in _headers.
frameOptions.note: A header file, for a host that reads one; wf start serves it.

sitemap.how: meta.site_url: the build writes sitemap.xml from the site's routes.

canonical.how: meta.site_url: every page gets its canonical link.

jsonLd.how: meta.site_url: every page gets WebSite, owner, WebPage and breadcrumb JSON-LD.
